title: Living by Faith, Not by Sight
speaker: Min. Emmanuel Inyang
description: Discover how to navigate life's uncertainties through unwavering faith in God's promises. This powerful message explores 2 Corinthians 5:7 and offers practical insights for daily Christian living.

title: The Power of Prayer
speaker: Min. Anietie Etuk
description: Learn how prayer transforms our relationship with God and impacts the world around us. Discover the principles of effective prayer and how to develop a dynamic prayer life.

title: Grace That Sustains
speaker: Bro. Uyobong Uko
description: God's grace is not just for salvation; it sustains us daily. Explore how grace empowers us to overcome challenges and live victoriously in Christ.

title: Finding Your Purpose
speaker: Bro. Sandy Sandy
description: Discover how to align your life with God's purpose and experience the joy of fulfilling His call on your life.

title: The Resurrection Hope
speaker: Bro. Wisdom Johnson
description: The resurrection of Jesus is the foundation of our faith. Understand what the resurrection means for our present and future.

title: Love in Action
speaker: Min. Anietie Etuk
description: Love is more than a feeling; it's a choice and an action. Learn how to express God's love authentically in your relationships.
